lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. A distinct vertical alignment of four primary spots is positioned immediately behind the fifth gill slit, with a secondary staggered column further posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two prominent linear features run horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance blobs. Several elongated, lower-luminance shapes consistent with remoras are visible on the ventral-lateral surface below the pectoral fin attachment.
